name: What if the lot already has a pool or large patio?

mainEntity.name: Can a detached ADU still fit if the backyard already has a pool, spa, or major patio area?
mainEntity.text: Can a detached ADU still fit if the backyard already has a pool, spa, or major patio area?

acceptedAnswer.text: Existing backyard features can dramatically change detached ADU feasibility. A pool, spa, extensive patio, or mature landscaping may already occupy the best part of the lot, leaving less room than expected for new construction. The design should start by mapping all fixed elements and then testing what remains. Homeowners often discover that the ADU can still fit, but only with a smaller footprint, a different orientation, or a revised outdoor layout. Drainage, privacy, and construction access become especially important when the backyard is already built out. In some cases, the ADU can be integrated into the landscape plan so the new structure complements the pool or patio rather than competing with it. The key is to evaluate the full yard as one system instead of treating the ADU as an isolated object.
acceptedAnswer.description: A detached ADU can still be possible on a lot with a pool or large patio, but the design must work around existing hardscape, circulation, drainage, and required setbacks. The usable building area may be smaller than it first appears.
